name: Project Survival [BETA]
desc:
Survive endless onslaughts of enemies who are dead set on the destruction of your Sigil.
Loot for useful supplies in an infested world. Craft barricades, traps and weapons to delay the inevitable.
Don't bother counting; there's too many of them. Keep your senses sharp. Shoot until they stop.

Best played with friends.
